description.value: Barnet Beach Cafe (officially listed as Barnet Marine Park Café by its operator, Burnaby Hospitality) is a seasonal café situated within Barnet Marine Park on the shores of Burrard Inlet. The park setting makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Barnet Highway corridor or the nearby Burnaby Mountain trails. It is one of several city-operated café locations managed under the Burnaby Hospitality umbrella.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record points to foodburnaby.ca/cafes/barnet-marine-park-cafe; the fetched website confirms Barnet Marine Park Café exists as one of many cafés operated by Burnaby Hospitality, and the phone prefix '604-297-48...' visible in the footer matches the OSM phone. The website provides no café-specific amenity details beyond what OSM tags supply, so Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan) and outdoor seating cannot be independently confirmed from website text. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Barnet Beach Cafe' while the operator's website consistently uses 'Barnet Marine Park Café', and the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' while the operator is Burnaby Hospitality and the address is in Burnaby.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Barnet Beach Cafe' but the operator's website (foodburnaby.ca) consistently uses 'Barnet Marine Park Café' — the OSM name may be informal or outdated.
OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the café is operated by Burnaby Hospitality and located in Burnaby — the community tag appears to be incorrect.
Fetched website content is the generic Burnaby Hospitality homepage with no café-specific page content; amenity details could not be confirmed from the website.
